diffSummary: The browser now uses authenticated database APIs as the formal business truth.
Remote bootstrap, offline/read-only, retry, revision-conflict and last-sync states are production-safe.
Temporary passwords are enforced at both API and UI boundaries.
Role-restricted local-v5 migration is hidden from operators.
Cross-day audit history covers deleted, sold and transitioned objects without exposing audit snapshots.

finalVerification.builds: contracts, database, api and web passed

deferredToStaging: Real PostgreSQL integration and migration execution
Authenticated browser E2E against a deployed API
rationale: All locally verifiable web/API integration boundaries are implemented and passing. Networked infrastructure and real-device checks belong to deployment/Staging verification.
